notes.en: Official program reference: one semester or longer; 20 periods/week (45 minutes each). The reference table lists CNY 7,300 tuition, 400 registration and 500 insurance per semester, or 14,600 tuition, 600 registration and 1,000 insurance per academic year. December 20 is the recurring spring deadline without a stated year. English text explicitly dates spring teaching to 2026; Chinese text dates autumn teaching to September 2026–January/July 2027. These do not confirm the Spring 2027 teaching calendar, exact application dates or current fees. Application opening is unannounced; age 16–60 has a documented older-applicant health/guarantor exception. Contact admission@xisu.edu.cn.
